items.title: 63476_Jimmie Crawford oral history interview
items.q: I didn't study no drums until I was with a Broadway musical, from Freddy Albright. He was a good teacher

ctx.x: Yeah, because I remember reading once Gene Krupa said that, when he first saw Duke's band and saw all this equipment that Sonny Greer had, he went and told his mother that he wanted to get a tympani or something, and she went out and got it.

Yeah, but I've had a tympani also, but I never had no education on it. I didn't study no drums until I was with a Broadway musical, from Freddy Albright. He was a good teacher, good stick man. He was older than I, and every time he -- well, he was chosen to be the drummer, and -- with one of the symphonic leaders --
